name: Why is sequencing important for construction trades?
description: Sequencing establishes a logical order for construction tasks, preventing conflicts and ensuring efficiency.

mainEntity.name: Why is sequencing important for construction trades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sequencing is crucial for construction trades to ensure efficiency, safety, and quality. It establishes a logical order for tasks, preventing conflicts where one trade's work might impede another's or damage recently completed work. For example, rough plumbing and electrical work must be completed before drywall installation. Proper sequencing helps avoid rework, reduces downtime, and ensures that the project progresses smoothly from foundation to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sequencing establishes a logical order for construction tasks, preventing conflicts and ensuring efficiency.
